people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.
translations.bsb: They said this to test Him, in order to have a basis for accusing Him. But Jesus bent down and began to write on the ground with His finger.
translations.kjv: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.
translations.asv: And this they said, trying him, that they might have whereof to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground.
